brief: A red around €25 as a gift for someone who likes Italian wine.

criteria.notes: red, Italian, a gift; 'around €25' taken as €20–30 before searching

shortlist.name: Banfi Chianti Classico Riserve D.O.C.G., 0,75 l
shortlist.reason: Tuscan Chianti Classico Riserva from a well-known estate, aged 24 months in oak, at almost exactly €25; dry, 13.5%, and the only wine whose page confirms stock.

shortlist.name: Vynas Ruffino Riserva Ducale Chianti Classico Riserva D.O.C.G. 0,75 l
shortlist.reason: A classic Italian gift label: Chianti Classico Riserva, 80% Sangiovese, aged 24 months, dry, 14%, at €24.95. Delivery takes 1-3 working days and stock is not stated.

rejected.reason: 30.49 on the page ('30 49 €'), 0.49 over the €30 ceiling. Otherwise a strong gift: Barolo, 100% Nebbiolo, 14%, 0.75 l.

notes: Only two wines fit. The €20–30 band was fixed before searching, as the skill defines 'around €25', and both Barolos landed just outside it (19.99 and 30.49); a shopper would probably accept either, so the short list is partly an effect of the hard band. Three more product pages on the five shops appeared in the results but were not read because their snippets put them far outside the band (Rimi Campagnola Ripasso and Sensi Chianti Riserva under €15, Vynomeka Bersano Barolo about €35); 2 of 8 page reads were left unused. The Vynomeka price appears as '2495 €' with the decimal separator lost; read as 24.95 because the same page prints its 80.00 € free-delivery threshold as '8000 €'. Producer is null for the Ruffino because the page has no producer field.
